headline: Dolphins’ De’Von Achane Suffers ACL Tear

headline: J.J. McCarthy traded to Giants: Will he succeed in New York?
summary: With Jaxson Dart out for the season, the Giants dealt a fifth-round pick to Minnesota for McCarthy. But does this move the needle for New York? Can it work?

headline: Vikings TE Josh Oliver Suffers Torn Biceps
summary: Josh Oliver was injured yesterday, and he may not return in 2026. headline: John Harbaugh: Giants have to overcome the shock of losing our QB and best defensive player
summary: Last Monday night the Giants lost starting quarterback Jaxson Dart for the season, and on Sunday they lost pass rusher Brian Burns for the season.

headline: Sources: Jets RB Breece Hall week-to-week with quad injury
summary: Jets running back Breece Hall, who suffered a quad injury in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Lions, is considered week-to-week, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: Evans, Williams, Greenlaw don't have long-term injuries, 49ers say
summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that injuries sustained by Mike Evans, Trent Williams and Dre Greenlaw on Sunday aren't considered long-term issues.
